name: Struve 2398 B
description: A nearby red dwarf, 32% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725B: radius in solar radii, 0.3232 +/- 0.0061, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725B: mass 0.235 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 725B: effective temperature in K, 3104 +/- 28, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 32% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.3232 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,104 K.
